name: Campingplatz Demmelhof
beschreibung: The Demmelhof campsite is located in St. Johann in Tirol, directly at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser massif. The surroundings are characterized by alpine pastures, forests and an extensive network of hiking and cycling trails. The facilities include spacious pitches, modern sanitary facilities and a wellness area with pool and sauna. A restaurant with Tiroler cuisine as well as a bread roll service are available on site. The atmosphere on the well-kept grounds is quiet and family-friendly. The year-round offering is aimed at families, hikers, cyclists and winter sports enthusiasts. In winter, guests benefit from the direct location on the cross-country ski trails and the proximity to the ski areas. Thus, the campsite serves as an ideal starting point for active holidaymakers looking for comfortable accommodation in nature.
